before.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the supplied CSV and compute the mean waiting time for each month.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/clinic_ja.csv')
monthly = df.groupby('年月', as_index=False)['平均待ち時間'].mean()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
ax.plot(monthly['年月'], monthly['平均待ち時間'], marker='o')
ax.set_title('年月ごとの平均待ち時間')
ax.set_xlabel('年月')
ax.set_ylabel('平均待ち時間')
ax.set_ylim(0, monthly['平均待ち時間'].max() * 1.1)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
fig.tight_layout()
